_comment: Burning quota far faster than the window can sustain. Session: 2h of 5h elapsed (40% expected) at 85% used -> ratio ~2.1, Overuse. Weekly: 2d of 7d elapsed (29% expected) at 75% used -> ratio ~2.6, HeavyOveruse. Expect the flame badge and a 'Used 85% vs 40%' pace line. Quota percentages are deliberately below the warning threshold so a red icon here means the pace band drove it, not the quota.
